ItemID: NA; Title: SAMSUNG T7 Portable SSD 500GB - Up to 1050MB/s - USB 3.2 External Solid State Drive, Blue (MU-PC500H/AM); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd consider a compact drive for moving files alongside my older desktop external drive.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Soundcore Anker Life Q20 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Headphones, Wireless Over Ear Bluetooth Headphones, 40H Playtime, Hi-Res Audio, Deep Bass, Memory Foam Ear Cups, for Travel, Home Office; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Headphones aren't something I'm looking for right now; computer and home-device accessories interest me more.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger display interests me, but I recently bought a Show 5 and its stand, so I'd pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd explore this as an extension of my door alarms, especially given my existing Alexa devices.
ItemID: NA; Title: Seagate Exos X18 16TB Enterprise HDD - CMR 3.5 Inch Hyperscale SATA 6Gb/s, 7200 RPM, 512e and 4Kn FastFormat, Low Latency with Enhanced Caching (ST16000NM000J); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An enterprise internal drive feels excessive; my history points more toward convenient external storage.
ItemID: NA; Title: HDMI Switch Aluminum 4K 60Hz, JSAUX Bi-Directional HDMI Splitter 2 in 1 Out, 1 Input 2 Output HDMI Switcher 2 Ports, Manual Monitor Splitter 2 x 1/1 x 2 UHD 1080P 3D Compatible for Box PS4 -Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could help connect my Blu-ray player and Fire TV, but I'd check whether I actually need extra HDMI switching first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Samsung 970 EVO Plus SSD 2TB NVMe M.2 Internal Solid State Hard Drive, V-NAND Technology, Storage and Memory Expansion for Gaming, Graphics w/ Heat Control, Max Speed, MZ-V7S2T0B/AM; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I'm not planning an internal computer upgrade, and I haven't established that my computer supports this drive.
ItemID: NA; Title: 1 Foot Short USB C Cord Fast Charge 5 Pack Durable USB A to USB Type C 3A Fast Charging Cable for Charging Station Compatible with Samsung Galaxy Note 20 A20 A51 S10 S20 Plus Ultra LG Stylo K51; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I don't have a clear need for five short USB-C charging cables right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: JOUNIVO USB Microphone for Computer, PC/Laptop Mic, Mute Button with LED Indicator, 360 Degree Gooseneck Design, Desktop Microphone for Streaming, Recording, Dictation, Podcasting, YouTube, JV610; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My webcam already includes a microphone, and I don't currently have a reason to add a separate desktop mic.
